_note: A tag name runs to the next whitespace, `/` or `>`, as the Svelte parser reads it, so `<Child$x>` is the component `Child$x` and `<kids.$Kid>` the component `kids.$Kid`. Stopping the name at the `$` read `<Child$x>` as `<Child>` with a `$x` attribute and `<kids.$Kid>` as an element named `kids.`, and the file was dropped from the run. svelte-check moves a missing-prop error onto the tag name as its HTML scanner reads it, which ends before the `$`.
